intent: Second small art repaint: three more playable foes and four recognizable old icons.

prompt_templates.foe-left: Edit the first reference into a finished enemy sprite for Rootward. Use the second reference, Vesper, only for character art quality: clean anime/chibi contours, dimensional controlled cel shading and appealing clarity. Subject: {subject} Place the foe on the RIGHT of a side-view battle and pose it decisively facing SCREEN LEFT toward the player; eyes, mouth and main threatening gesture lead left. Preserve recognizable identity, colors and overall scale from the source. One full-body creature centered, entire silhouette visible, sufficiently simple to read at 170 pixels tall. Transparent background, no floor, no scenery, no text, no frame, no UI, no watermark.
prompt_templates.inventory: Edit the first reference image into a finished Rootward inventory icon. The second reference is the newer card art style reference only. Subject: {subject} Improve the old art's shape and quality while preserving its elemental palette and identity. Crisp high-quality hand-pixelled fantasy RPG object, deliberate blocky pixel clusters, bronze machinery, richly saturated magic, bright focal center and dark readable contour. Must remain distinct when shown only 30 pixels wide in a relic row or shard chip. One object filling 82% of a square canvas, transparent background, no scenery, no frame, no lettering, no UI, no watermark.

assets.subject: Fork Bomb: a cheeky round dark-navy clockwork bomb creature with two orange glowing eyes, a dangerous toothy grin, stubby metal feet and a sparking lit fuse; a faint duplicate spark near it hints at copying itself. Keep the recognizable black bomb body and gold-orange face.

Type Mimic: a compact red-brown treasure chest monster with a large fanged open lid, one long pink tongue, a single top eye and blue elemental sparks licking from its corners. Keep the original chest silhouette, shifting magic and comic menace.

Segfault Specter: a torn smoky gray hooded ghost with a sharply glowing red fractured core, one pale mask fragment, spiky black tendrils and subtle magenta glitch sparks. Keep original hood, red face and spectral shape.

Mana Capacitor relic: a small violet crystal battery held by a squat bronze casing, with a single luminous power reservoir visible through an opening. Distinct capsule silhouette, instantly reads as stored arcane energy.
Prismatic Dynamo relic: a compact square bronze generator with one clear rainbow prism spinning in the center and four tiny cyan electrical contacts. Distinct from a mirror or coin.
Kindle shard: one narrow red-orange ember crystal with a living flame tip and a small bronze socket at its base, bold vertical silhouette.
Ward shard: a circular violet and teal protective focus, with one solid turquoise shield emblem in the middle, thin bronze ring and four violet facets. Strong clear shield reading at small size.
